merge.why: USER RULING 2026-11-12: 'I don't see many good merges. Probably Wooded Foothills and Stomping Ground is a reasonable one after the modifications.' After INT-9's MorphProvider fetch prune, Wooded Foothills is cracked on play for Stomping Ground (untapped for 2 life), so in a goldfish it is a Stomping Ground costing one more life that also thins the library.

keep_apart.why: USER RULING 2026-11-12: 'Other than that maybe the dorks, but exalted can matter. So that leans toward K=18.' Ignoble Hierarch's exalted adds a point of combat damage that pump doublers (Berserk, Legion Leadership, Temur Battle Rage) multiply; Birds makes any colour and has flying.
